nina: Heads-up: SAST pipeline flagged a high severity 'auth bypass' in artifact-fetcher module, but CI shows 403s for scanner earlier. linking threads.

oscar: can you paste the finding? sometimes it's a noisy pattern (regex match) on our custom auth wrapper.

nina: snippet: `if (!user || !user.roles.includes('reader')) return false;` flagged as missing null-check leading to bypass.

maya: that code is used only after KMS-decrypt for artifact tokens; if KMS fails, caller path changes and we might get a false-positive.

infra-bot: [audit] DetachRolePolicy scanner-runner-prod at 2024-08-01T18:23:12 by infra-bot (PR #4510).

sec-bot: triage request created: TR-2024-88 (assigned to maya). Suggest running local DAST to confirm exploitation path.

oscar: quick triage plan: (1) reproduce SAST finding locally with sample payloads (2) run DAST against staging artifacts endpoint to try exploit (3) check CloudTrail for role/keystore changes that might alter auth flow.

oncall: also note: if KMS denies, artifact-fetcher responds 403; we should ensure we don't degrade into open allow. add test asserting 403 on failed-decrypt path.

maya: reproducing now. prelim: SAST pattern matches a defensive check but runtime depends on upstream token parse which can be null if decrypt fails. adding a guard to explicitly fail closed on decrypt errors.

nina: good. after patch, run full SAST+DAST and attach results to TR-2024-88. also optional: add an infra preflight that simulates kms:Decrypt denied to catch behavioral regressions.

oscar: I'll add the preflight checkbox to policy-change PR template.

maya: patch pushed, CI queued 6765600036. will report back with DAST results.

sec-bot: CI SAST+DAST run queued -> monitoring.

nina: thanks — we'll close TR after verification and include the audit log snippet showing the DetachRolePolicy that precipitated this.

oscar: +1, and propose adding a lint rule to flag auth wrappers that assume non-null upstream tokens.

maya: noted. closing interim thread when CI passes. :white_check_mark:
